title: Multiple Explosions Strike Saudi Arabia After Houthi Attacks on Yemeni Oil Facilities
detail: Multiple explosions struck Saudi Arabia following Houthi attacks and retaliatory Saudi coalition strikes on Yemeni oil facilities, marking a sharp escalation in cross-border strikes. The exchange represents a significant intensification of hostilities with direct implications for the Mecca Pact's collective defense framework.

media.caption: Multiple explosions strike Saudi Arabia amid Houthi-Saudi escalation

title: UK Demands Houthis Cease 'Reckless Attacks' on Saudi Arabia
detail: The UK government publicly demanded that Houthis stop their 'reckless attacks' on Saudi Arabia, adding Western diplomatic pressure to the escalating conflict. The statement signals growing international alignment behind the Mecca Pact members as Houthi strikes on Saudi territory intensify.

media.caption: UK demands Houthis halt reckless attacks on Saudi Arabia

title: Egypt Holds Funeral for Flight Attendant Killed in Houthi Missile Strike on Riyadh
detail: A funeral was held in Egypt for an Egyptian flight attendant killed in the Houthi missile strike on Riyadh, highlighting the civilian toll from the escalating Houthi-Saudi Arabia conflict. The death of an Egyptian national adds pressure on Egypt, a prospective Mecca Pact accession candidate, as it navigates its response to the intensifying conflict.

media.caption: Funeral held in Egypt for flight attendant killed in Houthi strike on Riyadh
